title: Reopen excursion
purpose: Reopen a closed excursion so it can be corrected and reviewed again.
summary: Reopen a closed excursion so it can be corrected and reviewed again. Managers and administrators only.

tasks.title: Reopen it
steps: Give the [[Reason for reopening]] and select [[Reopen excursion]].

tasks.title: Add information without reopening
steps: Use Add note on the excursion. It works in any state.

good_to_know: The reason is kept in the timeline.
It must be submitted and reviewed again to close.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: Managers and administrators. When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice that gives the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee. Only a closed excursion can be reopened.

If someone else changed the record after you opened this form, the save is refused with a message that it changed since you opened it. Nothing is saved; reload, check the current values and enter the change again.

items.label: Reason for reopening
items.description: Required, up to 4,000 characters. Kept in the timeline. Do not enter donor, patient or participant names or other text that could identify a person.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Reopen excursion returns it to Open and clears the earlier submission and closure details; the earlier closing entry and its note stay in the timeline. The specimen list captured at closing stays with the record, the page shows the live list while it is open, and closing it again captures a new list.

sections.title: Manual holds
paragraphs: Holds placed from an excursion remain ordinary manual holds on the selected specimens. Submitting, closing, returning or reopening an excursion never releases them. A manager or administrator reviews and releases each from its specimen record with a reason.
